title: Lesson 32 - Extending the Model with Custom Data Model Objects and Relationships
description: Model data in Data 360., focused on extending the customer 360 model with custom data model objects, defining their relationships, and how custom objects participate in unification.

questions.question: When is a custom Data Model Object the right choice over adding fields to a standard object?
options: When the data is organization-specific and does not fit a standard subject area, and you also define its relationships into the model.
Whenever you need to store any new field.
questions.explanation: Custom objects are for genuinely distinct data that a standard subject area does not cover, and they must be wired into the model with relationships. Standard objects can be extended with fields, so 'never' and 'any new field' are both wrong, and there is no sandbox-only rule.

questions.question: A custom Data Model Object holds the right rows but never appears in segments about people. What is the most likely gap?
options: It must be converted into a standard object.
Its relationship to Individual, and the mapped Individual ID key, is missing, so records are not tied to a person.
Custom objects cannot be used in segments.
questions.explanation: Without the relationship to Individual and a populated Individual ID, the custom object's records never attach to a person, so person-based segments exclude them. Page layouts do not apply here, custom objects can be segmented once joined, and conversion is not required.

questions.question: For a custom Data Model Object to contribute to identity resolution, what must be true?
options: It must be a Data Lake Object.
Identity resolution includes every object automatically.
It must be a standard object first.
It must be referenced by the identity resolution ruleset, with its relevant key fields populated.
questions.explanation: Identity resolution considers only the objects the ruleset names, and matching needs populated keys, so a referenced object with populated keys can contribute. Nothing is included automatically, and neither the object type nor a conversion makes it match.
